verdict.rationale: Otter documents its own cross-meeting search: AI Chat searches across your meetings (otter-docs-1), natural-language search finds insights from past calls (otter-docs-11), uploads become searchable text (otter-docs-14), and transcripts are searchable across all time periods (otter-docs-18). One user also reports using it to go back to details from past meetings (otter-comm-13). However, nothing in the evidence shows jumping to the exact timestamp or audio moment where something was said, and search scope over summaries and notes is only implied, not explicit. Missing for 10: documented jump-to-timestamp/playback from search results, explicit first-party full-text search across summaries and notes, independent hands-on corroboration of search accuracy.
